buildingUrl.text: The Medallion - Fully Furnished Flexible Leases 30+ Days

description:
Welcome to McKenzie Place, Madison's premier choice for upscale living. Our one to three-bedroom apartment homes are thoughtfully designed to match your lifestyle. Enjoy spacious open floor plans, luxurious granite countertops, and sleek stainless steel appliances. Each apartment is equipped with a washer, dryer, and a fully appointed kitchen, offering the ultimate in convenience.
Located in the vibrant North/East side of Madison, you're just moments away from everything you desire. McKenzie Place is a pet-friendly community, complete with a convenient dog wash station to pamper your furry family members. Indulge in our top-tier amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center and a stunning rooftop terrace with grills, perfect for relaxation and entertaining.

specialOffers.description: Look & Lease Special: Tour today and lease within 48 hours to receive 1 month of free rent (select 2-bedroom units only), and a reduced $500 security deposit.
